SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

2. Which statement about Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe.
   B. Say Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Scientific Theory about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Scientific Theory about Human Origin as rumours only.
   B. Say Scientific Theory about Human Origin never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Scientific Theory about Human Origin.
   D. Explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal skills is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Diversity and interpersonal skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Diversity and interpersonal skills as rumours only.
   C. Say Diversity and interpersonal skills never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal skills.

5. Which statement about Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain as rumours only.
   B. Explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain.
   D. Say Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain never happens in Kenya.

6. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

7. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.

8. Which statement about Vegetation in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Vegetation in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Say Vegetation in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Vegetation in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Africa.

9. Which statement about Self- Esteem Assessment is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Self- Esteem Assessment with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Self- Esteem Assessment never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Self- Esteem Assessment as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Esteem Assessment.

10. Which statement about Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● as rumours only.
   C. Explain Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ●.

11. Which statement about Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration as rumours only.
   C. Say Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration.

12. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Littering in markets

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Self- Improvement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Self- Esteem Assessment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
